name: canilivethere
description: Developer tooling for the CanILiveThere site. The site itself is backend-free and ships NO JavaScript dependencies: every page is plain HTML, CSS and browser ES modules, and nothing under node_modules/ is ever served to a reader. This file exists for one reason -- so the site can be opened in a real rendered browser DOM before publication, instead of being reviewed by reading its source. See the 'Inspecting a rendered page' section of README.md.
